comparison.objective: Tune a robot-axis shock absorber versus pour exactly the counted tablets into a held vial.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar rotation, and locking versus bimanual vessel positioning and controlled granular pouring.
comparison.success_condition: Two repeatable non-bottoming stops within energy and velocity limits versus exactly ten designated tablets transferred with none spilled or extra.
comparison.reason: Dynamic commissioning and granular transfer test different abilities; all three available spec versions were consistent enough to establish distinction.
